• Rigor, senso organizzativo e spirito di squadra.

• Esperienza nelle discussioni con vari interlocutori.

• Contratto con durata massima di 3 mesi.

• Tasso di partecipazione: 100%.

The Hospital of La Tour brings together the best of two worlds. Private medicine in an environment that stimulates the development of competence. Independent practice coupled with the institutional support of physicians in research and quality.

At La Tour Hospital, we strive to bring together the best talents around our patients, develop a team that is inspired by what is best in the world and be a place of motivation for health professionals who have the ambition to provide better care every day.

In order to strengthen our team, we are recruiting

Manager Procurement Medical Devices (MDC 3 months) (ref: 1991)

Your Mission

Within the Supply Chain of the Hospital of La Tour, you contribute to the proper functioning of the purchases and supplies necessary for the care of patients.

As part of a temporary replacement, we are looking for a rapidly operational person, able to ensure the continuity of purchasing activities and to work independently within a dynamic team of buyers and supply chain specialists.

Your responsibilities

• Ensure operational monitoring of procurement and vendor files.

• Manage the creation and updating of articles in our systems.

• Ensure the reliability of medical items and devices.

• Participate in the management of supply disruptions and the search for alternative solutions.

• Ensure the processing of security notices and materialisation activities.

• Contribute to the monitoring of procurement performance.

• Collaborate daily with medical, nursing, logistics and pharmaceutical teams.

• Participate in improvement projects and procurement structuring.

Your profile

• Commercial training, procurement, logistics or supply chain.

• Prior experience in procurement, procurement administration or supply chain.

• Ability to be self-sufficient quickly and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Good control of computer tools.

• Rigor, organizational sense and team spirit.

• Experience in discussions with various interlocutors.

We offer you

• Contract with maximum duration of 3 months.

• Participation rate: 100%.

• Start as soon as possible.

• Regular hours.

• The opportunity to integrate a recognised health organisation and contribute directly to the proper functioning of hospital activities.
